source_types.ifc_attribute: Direct attribute from the IFC entity (for example: Name, Description, Tag, ObjectType, GlobalId)
source_types.ifc_property: Property inside a Pset (read through ifcopenshell.util.element.get_psets / get_property)
source_types.ifc_class: IFC class/type of the occurrence, mapped to the project bSDD class
source_types.spatial: Derived from the spatial hierarchy (IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure / IfcRelNests)
source_types.aggregation_parent: Attribute from an assembly ancestor (IfcRelNests / IfcRelAggregates), by level: 1=direct parent, 2=grandparent, etc.
source_types.computed: Value calculated from a template or from other fields
source_types.manual: No IFC v2.1 correspondence; manual entry or custom Pset (Pset_LI_Extra / Pset_Procurement)
source_types.not_applicable: Item List control field with no relationship to the model (document status, free notes, etc.)

columns.notes: Maps the IFC ObjectType or occurrence class (for example: FlexiblePipeSegment) to the English project class name through subsea_flexible_classes.

IfcSite/IfcBuilding do not distinguish platform/well in this model. The exporter walks the Nests/Decomposes chain until it finds an ancestor whose Name contains '/' (for example, root segment 'P-52/7-RO-25D-RJS') and returns the full name. Add 'part_index' (0 or 1) in Extra Fields to extract one side only.
Sums length for classes with a 'Length' rule in quantity_by_class (for example: FlexiblePipeSegment); counts occurrences for the other classes.
Derives 'm' or 'un' from the same quantity_by_class rule used by the Quantity column.
Direct parent in the assembly chain (Nests/IfcRelAggregates). Empty if the occurrence has no assembly parent.
Grandparent in the assembly chain (2 levels up). Add more columns with level=3, 4, etc. to walk further up.

description_templates._comment: Accepted placeholders: {attr.AttributeName} and {Pset_Name.PropertyName}. Literal strings between placeholders are kept as written.
description_templates.FlexiblePipeSegment: Flexible pipe segment; Segment code: {attr.Tag}; Length (m): {Pset_FlexiblePipeSegment.NominalLength}; Standard envelope: {Pset_FlexiblePipeSegment.StructureCode}; Line inner diameter (in): {Pset_FlexiblePipeSegment.NominalInsideDiameter}; Supply unifilar drawing: {Pset_LI_Extra.UnifilarDrawingNumber}; Design water depth (m): {Pset_FlexiblePipeSegment.MaxWaterDepth}
description_templates.FlexiblePipeStructure: Flexible structure {attr.Description}; Design pressure = {Pset_FlexiblePipeSegment.MaxOperatingPressure} psi; Design water depth = {Pset_FlexiblePipeSegment.MaxWaterDepth} m
description_templates.AnodeCollarSet: Anode collar set: {Pset_AnodeCollarSet.AnodeCollarsQuantity} collars; total mass {Pset_AnodeCollarSet.AnodeMass} kg; service life {Pset_AnodeCollarSet.ServiceLife} years
description_templates.UNSStudSet: Stud set {Pset_StudSet.StudStandard} {Pset_StudSet.StudSize}; {Pset_StudSet.StudQuantity} studs, {Pset_StudSet.NutQuantity} nuts; surface treatment {Pset_StudSet.SurfaceTreatment}
description_templates.MetricStudSet: Stud set {Pset_StudSet.StudStandard} {Pset_StudSet.StudSize}; {Pset_StudSet.StudQuantity} studs, {Pset_StudSet.NutQuantity} nuts; surface treatment {Pset_StudSet.SurfaceTreatment}

quantity_by_class._comment: Qto and quantity read for the Quantity column, by class.
